steps.content: The Metropole Alliance, currently facing devastating losses against Augustus and her Reaper forces, is in a desperate position. Their understanding of Mania is limited, but they recognize its potential as a weapon. This desperation creates a critical opportunity for you.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: As you know, the Alliance has recently suffered repeated attacks from individuals with... anomalous capabilities. A new department was quietly formed to investigate these DisCity phenomena.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I am ${PlayerName}, the lead specialist appointed to the case.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: We detected a significant surge of anomalous power around this estate. Given the importance of your meeting, command sent me to assess the situation.
You aren't lying, not truly. This entire manor has been steeped in Hilda's Mania from the start, where anomalies may occur at any moment.
As you expected, your mention of "anomalous power" draws a measured glance from Hilda.

steps.speaker: Elegant Lady
steps.content: An "anomalous power expert"? ...Have you all heard of such a thing?

steps.speaker: Well-dressed Businessman
steps.content: DisCity's new assets have been a strategic nightmare... It's logical that the higher-ups would seek their own countermeasures. Still... an "expert"? Unverified.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: Understood, Mr. ${PlayerName}. Thank you for coming and offering your assistance.
steps.female_content: Understood, Ms. ${PlayerName}. Thank you for coming and offering your assistance.

steps.content: As skeptical murmurs ripple through the crowd, she offers a single, slow nod. Her expression remains an unreadable mask of ice. Whether she believes you or is merely playing along is impossible to discern. Without another word, she turns and withdraws from the gathering, returning to her place on the steps.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: My task is to complete the final integration testing and core calibration of the "Monolith" prototype within the next three days. The mole's objective will be equally clear—to either seize or sabotage it. Therefore, I will be staying in my room, dutifully serving as bait.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: I am, as you know, a cryptographer. My skills are in ciphers and systems, not counter-surveillance. Many of you are far more capable in that field. The mole is one, while the innocent are many. I would welcome the assistance of anyone in this room who considers themselves blameless.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: If you are uncertain how to proceed, then the best course of action is simple inaction. Wait. Watch. The day the "Monolith" is erected will be eventful enough, I promise you that.
Her gaze sweeps across the room, deliberate and assessing, before finally settling on you.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: Let's hope our collaboration over the next few days is a productive one.
The moment Hilda departs, a tense, murmuring energy fills the room. The crowd, once a unified audience, fractures into hushed clusters, dissecting her shocking announcement.
The mundane pretense of the seminar is gone, stripped away to reveal the raw anxiety of a mole hunt that now poisons the air, evident in every nervous gesture and whispered word.

steps.speaker: Edward
steps.content: Ah, ${PlayerName}... so that's your real name. Do you mind if I call you Officer ${PlayerName}?
Someone you don't remember is suddenly at your side, making you jump. Has he been here the entire time?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: A name doesn't matter much. What matters is knowing who you are and what you're here to do.

steps.speaker: Edward
steps.content: Meeting you truly feels like a stroke of luck, Officer. Though the rain chose such an inconvenient moment, it brought me here right to you, Officer ${PlayerName}. It's almost as if fate intended—
You cut short his sentimental speech, gesturing for him to look at several people standing nearby.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Do you know them?
Hilda is the bait. This entire gathering is a trap designed by her to force the agency's mole into the open.
Right now, your top priority is to gather intelligence—on Hilda, on every guest present. The source is irrelevant; the information is everything.
Just then, Edward lets out a distinctly delighted "Aha!"

steps.speaker: Edward
steps.content: Since arriving, I've made a point to speak with quite a few people, learn their public roles. Which one would you like to know about, Officer?

Hilda, a Sevael citizen and member of the Cryptography Department, specializes in codebreaking and engineering. Despite her talents, she has been denied promotions due to her parents' political stigma. Two years ago, she was transferred from the metropoles to DisCity, where she decrypted numerous classified communications and was promoted to senior officer. Six months ago, she was assigned to lead the secret "Monolith" project.

Manphist, a Sevael citizen and former head of the Cryptography Department, is a training instructor who was rehired after retirement. For several years, he has been undercover in DisCity. Renowned for his talent in spotting potential, he has cultivated numerous skilled spies for the metropoles.

Johnson, a Fraser socialite and director of the Wartime Economic Intelligence Center, serves as an economic advisor. A notorious playboy, he controls various financial channels and implements wartime sanctions against DisCity through economic pressure and smuggling operations.

options: Time is running short. Could you compile a report for me later?

steps.content: Helene, a DisCity native and junior officer in the Operations Department, was referred by Hilda. Skilled in song and dance, she frequents entertainment venues to charm high-ranking officials for intelligence. As a recent recruit, she only has access to low-level information.

Edward, a Sevael citizen referred by Manphist, is trained in stealth operations and theft. Deployed to DisCity three years ago, he infiltrated the Foreign Affairs Bureau as a diplomatic assistant to gather and relay intelligence.
It's remarkable how accurate Edward's briefings are, given how concise they are. The fact that he can organize intelligence on so many people in such a short time is extraordinary...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: This guy really does have a knack for intelligence work...
Suddenly, the crowd erupts in a crash of overturned furniture and shattering glass.

steps.speaker: Gangster-looking Man
steps.content: You got a death wish? Say that again. I dare you.

steps.speaker: Caustic Middle-aged Man
steps.content: I'll say it as many times as it takes. Her family's name is dirt. Everyone knows her parents were traitors who fled to DisCity. How do we know she's not just like them? What gives her the right to investigate us?

steps.speaker: Gangster-looking Man
steps.content: Go ahead and walk out. But you won't be leaving with your life.

steps.speaker: Caustic Middle-aged Man
steps.content: Marlo, have you lost your mind? Hilda's your boss, not your mom. Is she really worth dying for?!
A cold, furious laugh escapes Marlo. He pulls his pistol from its holster and, with a definitive crack, slams it onto the tabletop.

steps.speaker: Gangster-looking Man
steps.content: Let's get one thing straight: I'm not as nice as Hilda. I don't buy that "one mole hiding among innocents" crap. Far as I'm concerned, you're all suspects. Anyone tries to leave, I'll put a bullet in your head. Simple.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Who is he?

steps.speaker: Edward
steps.content: That's Marlo Bannings. I heard he and Hilda went to school together. He leads the Operations Department, has quite the reputation. But that tough act? Could all be a show, who knows...

steps.speaker: Edward
steps.content: The other one's embedded in DisCity's Propaganda Department. Name's... Horne, I think. Arrogant type. Looks down on just about everyone.
Before you've even finished with Edward, Marlo and Horne are already at each other's throats.

The outcome was inevitable: a desk jockey against an elite operative. Horne never stood a chance. Marlo dismantles him with brutal efficiency, and within seconds, a bloodied Horne crashes to the ground at your feet.

steps.speaker: Horne
steps.content: Help... help me...
His hand claws at your pant leg in desperation. But as you look down, you feel it unmistakably: <color=#fb9259>a strange fluctuation of Mania</color>.
Marlo is already moving, a tempest of rage. The slide of his pistol racks back with a sharp, metallic clack. There's no time to react.

options: I'm not going to let someone die in front of me.
